title: Paloma and the Alibi
premise: Estate lawyer Astrid Ishikawa is handed a will dated three days in the future, signed by a woman named Paloma Reyes who is, by every record, already dead. The client who delivers it — a nervous man paying triple rates — insists the murder hasn't happened yet, and that the will names the killer: whoever toasts first at the anniversary dinner. As Astrid traces the supposedly deceased witness through a city that keeps insisting she never existed, they discover Paloma staged her own death to trap a family that has killed before. At the dinner, the toast is raised, and Astrid must choose between handing the evidence to the law that failed Paloma once already, or letting her justice — outside the law — play out. In the end, the will is probated, the killer confesses on record, and Astrid, who has never belonged anywhere, finds they belong exactly here.
about_author: A. M. Reyes is the pen name of a former probate clerk who spent a decade reading other people's last words and decided to start inventing a few. They write mysteries about paperwork, ghosts of the legal variety, and the quiet violence of inheritance.

chapters.title: The Will Dated Tomorrow
chapters.summary: POV: Astrid. A retainer arrives with a will dated three days ahead, signed by Paloma Reyes — a woman whose death certificate Astrid themselves notarized last year. The client, Tomas, begs Astrid to prove no murder has occurred, offering a fortune to stop it before the anniversary dinner. The beat is cold dread: Astrid, a professional in endings, realizes they've been hired to prevent one.

chapters.title: Everyone Swears She's Dead
chapters.summary: POV: Astrid, alternating with Paloma's hidden journal entries. Astrid digs through records, funeral homes, and a seaside town where Paloma allegedly drowned, finding a witness everyone protects — and a family, the Vances, whose previous 'accidents' all preceded inheritance. Tomas disappears. The beat is rising paranoia: every answer confirms the murder is scheduled, and Astrid is now on the guest list.

chapters.title: The Anniversary Dinner
chapters.summary: POV: Astrid, infiltrating the Vance estate under pretext of reviewing the estate. The dinner unfolds in toasts and veiled threats; Astrid locates Paloma alive, hiding in the boathouse, and learns she authored the will to force the family's hand. When the eldest Vance raises the fatal glass, Astrid must intervene. The beat is the climax: love against duty, as Astrid chooses Paloma's plan over procedure.

chapters.title: Probate
chapters.summary: POV: Astrid. The confession is extracted on record, the killer taken by the law that arrives too late to matter, and Paloma — legally resurrected — signs the will that named her own murderer. Astrid files it, their first case where justice and the law finally shook hands. The beat is quiet resolution: belonging found in a profession of endings, and a new beginning with Paloma.
